intent: Sequence, timestamp and picture ID wraps with a 50 ms repair of seq 0: no requests, no loss, every frame written. RED on a stats or gap underflow at the wrap (PacketsLost ~65535, a spurious request), or on a writer that mishandles the ts wrap: it then counts every frame but the file holds half of them, which minVideoFrames and the frame-count check catch and monotonic does not.
